scenarios.name: sps_system_type_asc_p99_next
queries:
SELECT field_devices.id, fd_cursor.sps_number AS sort_value, CAST(fd_cursor.sps_number AS TEXT) AS cursor_value, CASE WHEN fd_cursor.sps_number IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS sort_value_null, fd_cursor.sps_document_name AS sort_second_value, CAST(fd_cursor.sps_document_name AS TEXT) AS cursor_second_value, CASE WHEN fd_cursor.sps_document_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS sort_second_value_null FROM "field_devices" JOIN field_device_cursor_values fd_cursor ON fd_cursor.field_device_id=field_devices.id WHERE (
		NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facility_aggregate_lifecycle WHERE kind='field_device' AND resource_id=field_devices.id)
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facility_aggregate_lifecycle WHERE kind='sps_controller_system_type' AND resource_id=field_devices.sps_controller_system_type_id)
		AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM facility_aggregate_lifecycle lifecycle
			JOIN sps_controller_system_types system_type ON system_type.id=field_devices.sps_controller_system_type_id
			WHERE lifecycle.kind='sps_controller' AND lifecycle.resource_id=system_type.sps_controller_id
		)
		AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1 FROM facility_aggregate_lifecycle lifecycle
			JOIN sps_controller_system_types system_type ON system_type.id=field_devices.sps_controller_system_type_id
			JOIN sps_controllers controller ON controller.id=system_type.sps_controller_id
			WHERE lifecycle.kind='control_cabinet' AND lifecycle.resource_id=controller.control_cabinet_id
		)) AND (CASE WHEN fd_cursor.sps_number IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END=0 AND fd_cursor.sps_number='990' AND CASE WHEN fd_cursor.sps_document_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END=1 AND fd_cursor.sps_document_name IS NULL AND fd_cursor.field_device_id > '08000000-0000-4000-8000-000000152c84') ORDER BY sort_value_null asc,sort_value asc,sort_second_value_null asc,sort_second_value asc,fd_cursor.field_device_id asc LIMIT 301
